MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 90
   C. 18
   D. 81

2. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 24
   C. 144
   D. 156

3. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x = 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x > 5

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 13
   C. 17
   D. 7

5. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

6. Solve for x: x + 4 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 14
   C. 4
   D. 11

7. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 5
   C. 24
   D. 25

8. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.205
   D. 0.025

9. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 50

10. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

11. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 13

12. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 24

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

2. Substitute values: Area = 9 × 9
3. Area = 81
Final Answer: 81 m²
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark
